answer: A hostile operator running 155 aliases therefore needs 160 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in dawn, expire in ridge, and echo lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3333 identities would post 2045 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
